verdict.reasons: The candidate correctly features the authoritative white-and-blue AFP drip-tape carton roll, fully visible with authentic, readable branding that matches the approved reference. The single commercial product is clearly separated from the installed infrastructure, acting as an illustration rather than operational plumbing. The installed evidence includes a small pressure gauge on a threaded port and a thin, flattened drip-tape lateral. The gauge face is angled away as required to avoid inventing a pressure rating. No core defects such as mixed product families, people, or impossible geometry are present. Minor surface imperfections on the gauge face text are advisory and do not affect the primary requirements.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
